evaluation.accurate_update: accepted and reference-valid and root errors within both unchanged gates
evaluation.all_updates_passed: Exactly one initialization and all179 updates accepted, reference-valid and root-accurate.
evaluation.frame: single origin fixed by first source reference; independent continuous-root composition
evaluation.invalid_labels: Retain completed sensor report, mark unavailable references and exit2.
evaluation.numeric_reference_poses_parsed: only after all operational fits for both independent branches

design.evidence_role: Previously viewed room and desk2 regression; no fresh holdout claim.

exit_status.1: Completed valid inputs with physical accuracy/availability failure.
exit_status.2: Invalid input, invalid labels or IO failure.

design.freeze: Metadata-only source/manifest/design binding before first new continuous run; output exclusive creation.

frontends.native: Unchanged original extractor with max400 features.

geometry.depth_stencil: All9 original measured depths valid, at most0.05m spread; nearest sample with fractional original-coordinate ray for multiscale.
geometry.reference_selection: accepted reference; never compose unconditional adjacent pairs across a failed acquisition

state.accepted_update: compose independently refined previous_from_current into reference root, then atomically replace reference/root/accepted acquisition timestamp
state.age_expiry: latch loss before image decoding; retain every subsequent rejected frame
state.duplicate_or_stale_rgb: reject without image decoding or permission renewal
state.initial_root: identity after measured depth geometry validation using unchanged VisualOdometry3dConfig::default(); at most256 valid initialization points
state.reference: last accepted measured RGB features, depth image and composed root pose
state.rejected_update: no root output or accepted-reference/root/timestamp renewal
state.rgb_observation: accepted-pose expiry checked first; strictly newer RGB observed before geometric fitting and remains observed if fit fails

source_reuse: Measurement functions feature_json/native/depth_point/pair/decode/verified/truth/interpolate/score/texture copied byte-for-byte from immutable pair prototype; private API prevented import. New sensor/state/evaluation/CLI functions are separately bound.
